arguments.message:
Hi there! The export feature in the dashboard is limited to 10,000 rows per download. This limit helps keep the export process running in your browser without timing out. If you need more data, you can:

1. Narrow the export using a date range or other filters so each export stays under 10,000 rows, and run multiple exports to cover the full period (e.g., one export per month).
2. Set up a scheduled export to cloud storage, which isn’t subject to the 10,000‑row cap.

Let me know if you need help setting up either option!
